title: 第十七章 入山
content_zh:
寅时三刻，陈默准时睁眼。

    无需依靠任何外在的提醒，身体深处那仿佛与生俱来、又或许是被这三年严苛作息锻造出的本能，在固定的时辰将他唤醒。窗外天色仍是沉沉的墨蓝，只有东方天际，有一线极淡的、几乎不存在的鱼肚白，预示着黎明将至。

    他没有立刻起身，只是静静地躺了片刻，感受着体内与昨日、与前日、与更久之前的细微不同。血筋膏的温厚药力似乎已完全化开，沉淀进四肢百骸，尤其是左肩伤处，那持续了月余的、无时无刻不在的钝痛，似乎减轻了微不可察的一丝，变得更为隐晦，只在特定角度的牵扯下才会骤然清晰。体内那缕暖流，在晨间自然醒来时，似乎也活泼凝实了些，静静盘踞在丹田，等待着意念的牵引。

    他缓缓坐起，动作比前几日流畅了些许，至少不再需要完全依赖右臂的支撑。左肩依旧虚垂着，不敢用力。他穿上那身最干净、也最破旧的粗布短褂，用布条将柴刀仔细绑在背后——这是他仅有的、可称为“依仗”的东西。又检查了一下怀里，苏芸给的清心丹小瓶贴身藏着，黑铁磨石也在。犹豫了一下，他将那本用油布包裹的周安笔记也塞进了怀里。进山认药，或许用得上。

    推开医舍吱呀作响的木门，清冽的、带着露水和草木气息的晨风扑面而来，瞬间驱散了最后一丝残存的睡意。吴医仆的房门紧闭，孙小海的鼾声从屋内隐约传来。陈默轻轻带上门，踩着被夜露打湿的、微凉的泥土地，向杂役院后门走去。

    时辰尚早，杂役院里一片寂静，只有远处井台传来隐约的打水声。他沿着熟悉的、被无数脚步磨得光滑的小径，很快来到了后门。说是门，其实只是一个简陋的、用木栅栏围出的缺口，平日里少有人走，栅栏上爬满了牵牛花的藤蔓，在晨光微熹中，深紫色的花朵含苞待放。

    苏芸已经到了。

    她依旧是昨日那身浅色粗布衣裙，站在栅栏旁一株老槐树的阴影下，身形显得有些单薄，但站姿笔直，像一杆修竹。晨风吹动她额前的碎发和衣角，她似乎毫不在意，只是静静望着远处雾气缭绕的山林轮廓。听到脚步声，她转过头来，目光落在陈默身上，点了点头，算是打过招呼。

    “走吧。”她没有多余的话，转身，率先从那简陋的木栅栏缺口走了出去，步入了后山那条被荒草掩盖大半的、崎岖小径。

    陈默紧随其后。一踏出那扇象征“杂役院范围”的木栅栏，空气似乎都变得不同了。少了人烟和劳作的气息，山林特有的、混杂着腐叶、泥土、露水和无数草木的、清新而又略带野性的气味，扑面而来。脚下是松软的、积着厚厚落叶的泥土，有些地方被夜露浸透，踩上去微微下陷，发出沙沙的轻响。小径蜿蜒向上，很快没入更深的林木之中。

    苏芸走得不快，但步伐很稳，似乎对这条路颇为熟悉。她很少回头，只是偶尔在岔路或需要攀爬陡坎时，会停下来，等陈默跟上，或者简单地指一下方向。她没有像在医舍时那样讲解草药，只是沉默地领路。

    陈默也没有说话，只是沉默地跟着，努力调整着自己的呼吸和步伐，尽量不让受伤的左肩受到太多颠簸。他能感觉到，进入山林后，体内的暖流似乎比在杂役院时活跃了一丝，运行也稍微顺畅了些。是灵气浓度不同的缘故吗？他不敢确定，只是默默体会着这种变化。

    山路渐陡，林木也越发茂密。参天古木的树冠遮蔽了大部分天光，使得林下光线幽暗，只有偶尔从枝叶缝隙漏下的、被切碎的光斑，在地上跳跃。鸟鸣声从四面八方传来，清脆悦耳，却也衬托出山林的深邃与寂静。空气中弥漫着潮湿的、略带霉味的腐殖质气息，以及各种不知名野花野草混合的复杂味道。

    走了约莫半个时辰，苏芸在一处略微开阔的、靠近一条潺潺溪流的林间空地停了下来。这里有一块巨大的、表面布满青苔的岩石，岩石下方，溪水在此形成了一个不大的、清澈见底的水潭。

    “歇一下。”苏芸在一块较为干燥的石头上坐下，从随身带着的一个小皮囊里倒出点清水，慢慢喝着。

    陈默也找了块平整的石头坐下，微微喘气。左肩伤处因持续的行走和偶尔的攀爬，传来清晰的酸痛，额角也渗出了细密的汗珠。但他精神尚可，目光不由自主地开始打量四周。这里的环境，与后山他常去砍柴的地方截然不同。树木更高大，植被更茂密，灵气似乎也……更浓郁一些？他能感觉到，在这里呼吸吐纳，似乎比在医舍更容易静心。

    “此处已近‘灵雾区’边缘。”苏芸仿佛看出了他的疑惑，开口道，“青云山脉，越往深处，灵气越浓郁，但也越危险。宗门划定的安全区域，大致到此为止。再往里，便可能遇到低阶妖兽、天然迷阵，或是一些不怀好意的散修、采药客。”

    灵雾区。陈默记下了这个词。原来，平日里砍柴挑水的地方，只是青云山脉最贫瘠、最安全的外围。

    “今日，我们只在这边缘活动。”苏芸站起身，走到溪边，指着水潭旁一丛叶片肥厚、呈墨绿色、边缘有细密锯齿的矮草道，“认得吗？”

    陈默凝目看去，摇了摇头。这草他没见过。

    “这是‘墨叶兰’，喜阴湿，多生于溪涧石缝。其根茎是炼制低阶‘回气散’的辅药之一，有微弱聚拢灵气、加快灵力恢复之效。但需三年以上年份，根茎呈深紫色方有效用。眼前这些，年份不足，效用微乎其微。”苏芸讲解道，又指了指旁边石头上几片不起眼的、灰褐色伞状菌类，“这是‘石耳’，并非灵药，但常年受此地淡薄灵气浸润，食之可清肺热，对火毒内蕴略有缓解。你可用它煮汤。”

    陈默仔细看着，将墨叶兰的形态、石耳的样貌，以及苏芸提到的生长环境、药性、辨识要点，一一记在心里。与他之前胡乱服用铁骨草不同，苏芸的讲解，更系统，也更强调“适用”与“限度”。

    “你体内火毒残余，与伤势纠缠，单靠丹药外力，难以尽除。需辅以食疗、环境，徐徐图之。”苏芸说着，俯身，用一把小巧的、看似普通的木片（边缘却很锋利），小心地采下几片品质较好的石耳，用一张洗净的大树叶包好，递给陈默。“拿着。回去与赤精枣、黄芪同煮，每日一次。”

    陈默接过，入手微凉湿润，带着菌类特有的气味。

    接着，苏芸又带他辨认了附近另外几种草药：一种开着小黄花、茎秆中空、名为“通心草”的植物，取其茎秆煮水，可疏通轻微经脉淤塞（苏芸提醒，对重伤者需慎用）；一种叶片狭长、呈锯齿状、揉碎后有辛辣气味的“醒神叶”，可提神醒脑，辅助入定，但不可多用，以免耗神；还有一种攀附在老树根部的、藤蔓呈暗红色、开淡紫色小花的“血藤”，取其嫩茎捣烂外敷，有微弱止血生肌之效，是低阶修士常用的外伤药替代品。

    苏芸一边讲解，一边示范采摘手法。她动作轻柔而精准，总是选取最合适的部分，且从不“竭泽而渔”，往往只取所需，留下大部分植株继续生长。陈默学得很认真，用还能动的右手，尝试着模仿她的动作，虽然笨拙，但也逐渐掌握了要领。他甚至拿出周安笔记，对照着上面的简图，发现苏芸所讲，比笔记上更加详细精准，尤其是关于药性搭配和禁忌的部分。
content_en:
At three o'clock in the morning, Chen Mo opened his eyes on time.
There is no need to rely on any external reminders. The instinct deep in his body that seems to be innate, or perhaps forged by these three years of rigorous work and rest, wakes him up at a fixed time.The sky outside the window is still dark blue, with only a very faint, almost non-existent line of fish belly white in the eastern sky, indicating that dawn is approaching.
He didn't get up immediately, but just lay quietly for a moment, feeling the subtle differences in his body from yesterday, the day before before, and even longer ago.The warm medicinal power of the blood tendon ointment seemed to have completely dissolved and settled into the limbs, especially the left shoulder injury. The ever-present dull pain that had lasted for more than a month seemed to have lightened up to an imperceptible level and became more obscure. It would only suddenly become clear when pulled from a specific angle.The warm current in the body seems to be more lively and solid when I wake up naturally in the morning, quietly lingering in the Dantian, waiting for the pull of thoughts.
He slowly sat up, his movements a little smoother than the previous few days, at least he no longer needed to rely entirely on the support of his right arm.The left shoulder was still hanging slumped, and I didn't dare to exert any force.He put on the cleanest and most shabby coarse cloth jacket, and carefully tied the hatchet behind his back with a strip of cloth - this was his only thing that could be called "reliance".He checked his arms again and found that the vial of Qingxin Dan given by Su Yun was hidden close to his body, as well as the black iron grindstone.After hesitating for a moment, he stuffed Zhou An's notebook wrapped in oilcloth into his arms.It might be useful to go into the mountains and find the medicine.
Pushing open the creaking wooden door of the hospital building, the crisp morning breeze with the smell of dew and vegetation blew into my face, instantly dispelling the last remaining drowsiness.The door of Doctor Wu's servant's room was closed tightly, and Sun Xiaohai's snoring could be heard faintly from inside the room.Chen Mo gently closed the door and walked towards the back door of the utility yard, stepping on the slightly cool soil that was wet with night dew.
It was still early, and the courtyard was silent, except for the faint sound of drawing water from the well in the distance.He followed the familiar path, smoothed by countless footsteps, and soon arrived at the back door.Called a door, it is actually just a simple gap enclosed by a wooden fence. Few people walk on it on weekdays. The fence is covered with morning glory vines, and in the faint morning light, deep purple flowers are in bud.
Su Yun has arrived.
She was still wearing the same light-colored coarse cloth dress as yesterday. She was standing in the shadow of an old locust tree next to the fence. Her figure looked a little thin, but she stood upright, like a slender bamboo pole.The morning breeze blew the hair on her forehead and the corners of her clothes, but she didn't seem to care. She just looked at the outline of the mist-shrouded mountains and forests in the distance.Hearing the footsteps, she turned around, her eyes fell on Chen Mo, and she nodded as a greeting.
"Let's go." Without any extra words, she turned around and took the lead to walk out through the gap in the simple wooden fence and entered the rugged path in the back mountain that was mostly covered by weeds.
Chen Mo followed closely behind.As soon as I stepped out of the wooden fence that symbolized the "men's yard area", the air seemed to be different.Without the smell of people and work, the fresh and slightly wild smell unique to the mountains and forests, mixed with rotting leaves, soil, dew and countless vegetation, hits the face.The soil beneath your feet is soft and covered with thick fallen leaves. Some places are soaked by night dew, and it sinks slightly when you step on it, making a soft rustling sound.The trail winds upwards and soon disappears deeper into the trees.
Su Yun didn't walk fast, but her steps were steady, and she seemed to be quite familiar with the road.She rarely looked back, but occasionally stopped when the road forked or needed to climb a steep hill, waiting for Chen Mo to follow, or simply pointing in the direction.She didn't explain the herbs as she did in the doctor's house, she just led the way silently.
Chen Mo didn't speak, just followed silently, trying to adjust his breathing and pace, trying not to bump his injured left shoulder too much.He could feel that after entering the forest, the warmth in his body seemed to be a little more active than when he was in the courtyard, and it ran a little smoother.Is it because of the different concentrations of spiritual energy?He wasn't sure, he just felt the change silently.
The mountain road becomes steeper and the trees become denser.The canopy of the towering ancient trees blocked most of the skylight, making the light under the forest dim. Only the occasional chopped-up light spots leaked through the gaps between the branches and leaves and danced on the ground.The chirping of birds comes from all directions, crisp and sweet, but it also sets off the depth and silence of the mountain forest.The air is filled with a moist, slightly musty smell of humus, as well as the complex smell of a variety of unknown wildflowers and weeds.
After walking for about half an hour, Su Yun stopped in a slightly open forest clearing near a gurgling stream.There is a huge rock with a moss-covered surface. Under the rock, the stream has formed a small, crystal clear pool.
"Take a rest." Su Yun sat down on a relatively dry stone, poured some water from a small leather bag she carried with her, and drank slowly.
Chen Mo also found a flat stone and sat down, breathing slightly.Due to the continuous walking and occasional climbing, there was clear pain in the left shoulder injury, and fine beads of sweat oozed from the forehead.But he was still in good spirits, and his eyes couldn't help but start looking around.The environment here is completely different from the place in the back mountain where he often cuts firewood.The trees are taller, the vegetation is denser, and the aura seems to be... richer?He could feel that breathing and breathing here seemed to be easier to meditate than in the hospital.
"This is close to the edge of the 'Spiritual Mist Area'." Su Yun seemed to have noticed his doubts and said, "The deeper you go in the Qingyun Mountains, the richer the spiritual energy, but also the more dangerous it is. The safe area designated by the sect roughly ends here. Going further in, you may encounter low-level monsters, natural mazes, or some unscrupulous cultivators and medicine collectors."
Lingwu District.Chen Mo memorized this word.It turns out that the place where people usually chop wood and carry water is just the barren and safest periphery of the Qingyun Mountains.
"Today, we are only moving around this edge." Su Yun stood up, walked to the stream, and pointed to a clump of short grass with thick, dark green leaves and finely jagged edges next to the pool, "Do you recognize it?"
Chen Mo looked at it intently and shook his head.He has never seen this grass before.
"This is 'Black Leaf Orchid', which likes dampness and humidity, and mostly grows in the cracks of rocks in streams. Its rhizome is one of the auxiliary medicines for refining the low-level 'Hui Qi Powder'. It has the effect of weakly gathering spiritual energy and accelerating the recovery of spiritual power. However, it takes more than three years for the rhizome to be dark purple to be effective. These are not old enough, and the effect isIt's very small." Su Yun explained, pointing to a few pieces of inconspicuous, gray-brown umbrella-shaped fungus on the stone next to it. "This is a 'stone ear'.It is not a magic medicine, but it is infiltrated by the weak spiritual energy of this place all year round. Eating it can clear away the heat in the lungs, and you can use it to make soup."
Chen Mo looked at it carefully and remembered the shape of the orchid, the appearance of the stone ear, the growth environment, medicinal properties, and identification points mentioned by Su Yun one by one.Unlike his previous random consumption of Iron Bone Grass, Su Yun's explanation was more systematic and emphasized "applicability" and "limitation".
"The remnants of the fire poison in your body are intertwined with the injury. It is difficult to remove them with the external force of pills. It needs to be supplemented with diet therapy and the environment, and it will be gradually eliminated." Su Yun said, leaning down, using a handful of small, seemingly ordinary wood chips (the edges were very sharp), carefully picked out a few pieces of better quality stone fungus, wrapped them in a large washed leaf, and handed them to Chen Mo."Take it. Go back and cook it with red dates and astragalus, once a day."
Chen Mo took it and felt it was slightly cool and moist, with the unique smell of fungi.
Then, Su Yun took him to identify several other nearby herbs: a plant with small yellow flowers and hollow stems called "Tongxincao". Boiling the stems in water can clear minor meridian congestion (Su Yun reminded that it should be used with caution for seriously injured people); a plant with long and narrow leaves, serrated, and a spicy smell after being crushedThe "Xingshen Ye" can refresh the mind and help to enter concentration, but it should not be used too much to avoid consuming the mind; there is also a "blood vine" that clings to the roots of old trees, has dark red vines and small lavender flowers. Take the young stems and pound them for external application. It has a weak hemostasis and muscle-building effect. It is a commonly used substitute for trauma medicine by low-level monks.
Su Yun explained and demonstrated picking techniques.Her movements are gentle and precise, and she always selects the most suitable part. She never "fishes for all" and often only takes what is needed, leaving most of the plant to continue to grow.Chen Mo studied very seriously and tried to imitate her movements with his right hand that could still move. Although he was clumsy, he gradually mastered the essentials.He even took out Zhou An's notes and compared them with the simple diagrams on them, and found that what Su Yun said was more detailed and accurate than what was in the notes, especially about the combination of medicinal properties and taboos.
